definitions.explanation: The act of waking up early in the morning. Can also describe a person who habitually wakes up early. Functions as a noun and as a suru-verb.

examples.japanese: {早起|はやお}きは{三文|さんもん}の{徳|とく}。
examples.english: The early bird catches the worm.
examples.notes: Famous proverb (lit. 'early rising is worth three mon')

examples.japanese: {明日|あした}は{早起|はやお}きしなければならない。
examples.english: I have to wake up early tomorrow.

notes:
Can be used as a noun ({早起|はやお}きが{得意|とくい} = good at getting up early) or with する ({早起|はやお}きする = to wake up early).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{早起|はやお}きする (wake up early)
・{早起|はやお}きは{三文|さんもん}の{徳|とく} (proverb: early rising is beneficial)
・{早起|はやお}きが{苦手|にがて} (bad at getting up early)

Opposite: {朝寝坊|あさねぼう} (oversleeping, late riser)
